biography.value: Stormborn are fast and hit with enough force to stun reliably at Margin 2. The combination of Momentum and their fly speed means they can build approach distance quickly and deliver Thunder Blow at subtract-1 to both dice consistently. A summoner who gives one space to maneuver will find it applies Stunned more frequently than the raw numbers suggest — the action economy value of reliably stunning a target for a round is significant at this tier.

system.attacksNotes:
Thunder Blow [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 10 feet.
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 lightning damage; pushed 10 feet + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 lightning damage + Stunned + Deafened for 1 minute from the thunderclap at impact.

Lightning Throw [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 lightning damage (8 + 3 Dex); target gains Dazed until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 2: 11 lightning damage, DR halved (round up); target Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Wind Aura: Ranged ### Attacks passing within 15 feet of the Stormborn add 1 to one die of the attacker's choice from wind interference. Powerful Build: The Stormborn counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Momentum: When the Stormborn moves at least 20 feet before making a melee attack, subtract 1 from both attack dice on that attack.
